title: Ni-doped carbon xerogels for H2 storage
material_description: CX16AOXI | Ni-doped by dry impregnation (Ni(NO3)2.6H2O solution, liquid volume equal to the support pore volume) of a KOH-activated, HNO3-oxidised resorcinol-formaldehyde carbon xerogel synthesised at initial pH 6.8 (mean mesopore size 16 nm); 9.7 wt% Ni (ICP)
purification_method: washed with 5 M HCl then distilled water to pH 6, dried at 110 C
activation_method: KOH chemical activation, KOH/precursor mass ratio 4 (wet impregnation), 750 C under N2 (5 C/min), 2 h
source_location: main p.9 (journal p.2730), Fig. 9, series CX16AOXI (filled triangles), highest-pressure marker
notes: archive: HYC-0108_fig9_CX16AOXI.json; Only the highest-pressure point is extracted (non-77 K isotherm). Point count = 13 markers per series (about 10-196 bar; markers of the four series overlap below 60 bar) plus an origin marker at 0 bar not counted. Same sample/temperature/basis as the Fig. 11b "Adsorbed hydrogen" curve (I7), whose end point is nearly identical; the paper does not say whether the two curves are the same run, so both are kept with separate isotherm_id. Temperature printed as 25 C (298 K in Section 2.7). Automatic volumetric apparatus working up to 20 MPa (ref. [39]), no manufacturer/model; manifold kept at 35 C, sample cell at 25 C in a liquid bath; "The manifold volume was calibrated with a standard volume, carrying out helium isotherms." Pre-treatment before each H2 isotherm: 2 h at 400 C in H2 (100 cm3/min); degassed in situ at 150 C under vacuum before and after (duration and end pressure not stated). H2 and He 99.9995%. Table 1 values are per total sample mass (printed uncertainties: SBET +/-5 m2/g, W0-N2 +/-0.01, VT +/-0.05, W0-CO2 +/-0.01 cm3/g, dp +/-1 nm); W0-N2 (wide micropores, N2 -196 C) and W0-CO2 (narrow micropores, CO2 0 C) by Dubinin-Radushkevich; VT from the N2 isotherm at saturation; dp = mean pore size by DFT on the N2 adsorption branch; BET from N2 at -196 C (Micromeritics Tristar 3000), BET P/P0 range not stated. Area measured on the Ni-doped sample; whether that sample had received the 400 C H2 pre-treatment used before the H2 isotherms is not stated. Table 4 (carbon-mass basis): SBET 1775 m2/g, W0(N2) 0.72, W0(CO2) 0.40 cm3/g. Ni: 9.7 wt% (ICP), 0.2 at% (XPS), particle size 2.7 nm (XRD); support CX16AOX oxidised with 5 N HNO3, 48 h, room temperature.
